entry.note: Return on each $1 meant for a pick; unspent money earns 0%.

quintiles.note: Average forward return by score quintile (Q1 = lowest score, Q5 = highest), averaged over all months

ic.note: Average monthly rank correlation between each signal and the next 1 / 3 months' return (0.02–0.05 is useful, >0.05 strong)

caveats: Only the chart-based parts of the score are tested (momentum & trend, FVG). Earnings revisions, quality, valuation and smart money have no free point-in-time history.
Survivorship bias: today's index members only, so delisted losers are missing. Compare strategies to the equal-weight basket, not just to SPY.
Monthly rebalancing at month-end closes, equal weights, 0.1% cost per side on changed positions; no taxes, no slippage beyond that.
